decisions.evidence: The four exact library prerequisite files exist as published imported pages with nonempty inventories, and all raw hashes equal research/math-imports.json pins. Their summaries and relevant member interfaces were read. A P-plan entry with items: [] is an empty planning inventory, not absence of its published prerequisite carrier. No page/source repair was made; the refuter independently reports the files present. This rejects the missing-page assertion, not a historical mathematical defect repaired later.

F5 cited the Statement of lem-tgr-isometry-natural-tensor-invariance, whose Killing hypothesis does not apply to K: L_K g=2g/L0. The general identity is elementary and appears in that proof, so this is a nonfatal citation gap, not a false conformal calculation. Replaced its authority with the unrestricted published coordinate Lie-derivative proposition and expanded metric compatibility/torsion-freeness locally.

Conformal Killing had no earlier exact definition in the Example or Killing-only definition supplier. Added the definition nabla_(a X_b)=lambda g_ab with X smooth, lambda a smooth real scalar on O, and the 1/2 symmetrization convention before its first use. The trace in step 4.1 verifies smoothness of the factor supplied pointwise by null rigidity.

The massive measure definition excludes M_*=0 and does not define the total null domain. Added nonzero null fibers H^+_{0,x}, their total domain over O, the explicit geodesic spray and the meaning of Lf=0 for smooth f there. Step 4.1 verifies smooth regular-level-set structure and tangency by a full metric-compatibility contraction. No null measure, normalization or empirical radiation assertion is introduced.
